answer: A datacenter or proxy pool as a result cannot mint a army of identities in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, because every identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The cedar cap is enforced at intake and canyon shows the per-origin counts. At most 3 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a crystal tag. That is 11 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
